observations: Photo 0: a layered, two-tone black game console lying flat, with a blue sticker/tag on one corner - body shape matches the original 'fat' PS4 design (glossy top strip over matte body), not the slim or pro design.
Photo 1: top-down view of the same console; 'SONY' text is faintly visible at bottom-left and a partial 'PS4' logo at bottom-right corner, confirming it is a Sony PlayStation 4.
No controller, cables, game discs, console rear/ports, serial number, or any receipt are visible in either photo.
No visible damage, discoloration, or dust in the two shots provided, but only the top and side of the shell are shown.

claims.claim: Comes with 10 games (FC27, God of War 4, GTA 5, Spider-Man, Sekiro, Resident Evil 2 Remake, etc.)
claims.evidence: No discs, game cases, or console library screen shown in either photo.
No controller visible in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Interior/seal cannot be seen from exterior shell photos.
Would require a power-on/usage clip; not shown.
Rear panel with ports is not shown in either photo.

risks.proof: Photo of the controller next to the console, with working analog sticks/buttons visible

risks.risk: Games not actually included or are digital/used discs with scratches
risks.proof: Photo of all 10 discs/cases laid out, or screenshot of the console's game library

risks.risk: Internal fault (HDD, overheating, disc drive) not visible externally
risks.proof: Short video of console powering on and reading a disc without noise/overheating
risks.if_unproven: priced as console with unverified function, worst case treated as not confirmed working

risks.risk: Ports (HDMI, USB, power) could be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: Close-up photo of rear port panel, ideally with cables attached

risks.risk: No proof of 'UK used' origin or receipt authenticity
risks.proof: Clear photo of the actual receipt with date/shop name visible

risks.risk: Console could be region-locked, hacked/jailbroken, or have unofficial firmware (not disclosed)
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard retail unit, no bonus value from hacking

proof_requests: Photo of the controller alongside the console
Photo of all 10 game discs/cases together
Photo or video of the rear port panel and a power-on test
Clear photo of the UK purchase receipt
Short video showing the console running a game without overheating or disc errors
response.reason: The console is clearly identifiable as a Sony PS4 'fat' model from the shell design and partial logo, but none of the seller's claims about games, controller, condition, or receipt are shown in the photos, so it must be priced at the worst case as a bare, unverified console matching the only comparable PS4 fat listing.
